kz-1e2mosj.p: What kind of animal is Goofy?
kz-1e2mosj.e: Goofy walks on two legs and talks, while Mickey's dog Pluto walks on four. It is a riddle fans have puzzled over for decades.

kz-zl44q5.p: What are Donald Duck's three nephews called?
kz-zl44q5.e: Ole, Dole and Doffen are their Norwegian names. In English they are called Huey, Dewey and Louie.

kz-njy04r.p: Who created Scrooge McDuck and drew the classic stories from Duckburg?
kz-njy04r.e: Barks worked anonymously for decades. Readers simply called him “the good artist”.

kz-141wa7z.p: Which 1940 Disney film has Mickey as the sorcerer's apprentice?
kz-141wa7z.e: The film sets pictures to classical music and was one of the first with stereo sound.

kz-1isd0m2.p: Which animation studio behind Toy Story did Disney buy in 2006?
kz-1isd0m2.e: The price was 7.4 billion dollars, which made Steve Jobs Disney's largest single shareholder.

kz-1d2fz5v.e: The phrase means “no worries”. The names Simba and Rafiki are also Swahili, for lion and friend.

kz-17k3xuz.p: How many fingers does Mickey Mouse have on each hand?
kz-17k3xuz.e: Four fingers were quicker to draw and looked smaller, like “a bunch of bananas”, as Walt Disney himself explained.

kz-166mil9.p: Who became Disney's first Black princess in 2009?
kz-166mil9.e: The Princess and the Frog is set in New Orleans in the 1920s.

kz-1vssbne.p: Which Hans Christian Andersen fairy tale is Frozen loosely based on?
kz-1vssbne.e: Prince Hans and Kristoff are named after the author Hans Christian Andersen.

kz-1cki6kl.p: In which city did the first Disneyland open in 1955?
kz-1cki6kl.e: The opening day went so badly that it was internally called “Black Sunday”: the tarmac was wet and the water fountains did not work.

kz-19misdb.p: True or false: Walt Disney himself provided the voice of Mickey Mouse in the first films.
kz-19misdb.e: He was Mickey's voice from 1928 to 1947.

kz-312hqf.p: True or false: Walt Disney was frozen after his death.
kz-312hqf.e: He was cremated in 1966, and his urn is in a cemetery in California. The freezing story is an urban legend.

kz-ac0j3l.p: How many fairy tales did H.C. Andersen write?
kz-ac0j3l.e: He also wrote novels, travel books, plays and around a thousand poems.

kz-1ysnz80.p: What was on a note beside H.C. Andersen's bed when he slept?
kz-1ysnz80.e: He was terrified of being buried alive, and also carried a rope on trips in case the hotel caught fire.

kz-co5vs6.p: Which English author did H.C. Andersen stay with for five weeks, to his host's considerable irritation?
kz-co5vs6.e: After the visit in 1857, Dickens put up a note in the guest room saying the weeks had felt like an eternity. They never wrote together again.

kz-1c9j7ue.p: How many years did Margrethe II sit on the throne?
kz-1c9j7ue.e: She became queen in January 1972 and abdicated on the same day 52 years later.

kz-eab94c.e: She has the name from her grandmother, Crown Princess Margareta of Sweden, who was called the same.

kz-laqf9k.e: Hobart is the capital of Tasmania. She met Crown Prince Frederik in a pub in Sydney during the 2000 Olympics.

kz-afnimk.p: Who was the first to reach the South Pole in 1911?
kz-afnimk.e: Amundsen beat Scott by 34 days. Scott and his men died on the way home.

kz-1n6idy8.p: Who were the first to climb Mount Everest in 1953?
kz-1n6idy8.e: New Zealander Edmund Hillary and the Sherpa Tenzing Norgay agreed never to say which of them stepped onto the summit first.

kz-1qckbo8.p: Which Dane is the only Dane to have received the Nobel Peace Prize?
kz-1qckbo8.e: The politician and peace activist Fredrik Bajer received the prize in 1908 for his work on arbitration between states.

kz-65cswz.p: Who refused to give up her seat on a bus in Montgomery in 1955?
kz-65cswz.e: The arrest sparked a bus boycott that lasted 381 days and was led by the young pastor Martin Luther King.

kz-z3qmgp.p: Who was the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic?
kz-z3qmgp.e: Earhart made the crossing in 1932. Five years later she disappeared over the Pacific while attempting to fly around the world.

kz-10ckku0.p: Which Danish polar explorer led the Thule expeditions by dog sled?
kz-10ckku0.e: On the fifth expedition he travelled by dog sled from Greenland to the Pacific.

kz-1h30vis.p: Which Danish prime minister became NATO Secretary General in 2009?
kz-1h30vis.e: He handed the prime minister's post to Lars Løkke Rasmussen and led NATO until 2014.

kz-1fbb1h9.p: Who became known as “the lady with the lamp” during the Crimean War?
kz-1fbb1h9.e: Nightingale made nursing a profession, and was a pioneer in statistics and graphics.

kz-18bs66l.p: Which explorer gave his name to America?
kz-18bs66l.e: A German mapmaker wrote “America” on a world map in 1507, because Vespucci was the first to argue that the land was a new continent.

kz-11jlxzs.p: Which Mexican painter is known for her self-portraits and her unibrow?
kz-11jlxzs.e: Kahlo began painting while bedridden after a bus accident at the age of 18.

kz-8o2bpq.p: Which Danish footballer collapsed with cardiac arrest during the Euro 2021 match against Finland?
kz-8o2bpq.e: Eriksen returned to the national team the following year and scored with his first kick of the ball.

kz-tlxsnz.p: Which Danish entertainer became world-famous in the USA with a grand piano and “phonetic punctuation”?
kz-tlxsnz.e: Borge fled Denmark in 1940 and learned English by going to the cinema.

kz-xlb7rl.e: The bear cub in the spotted trousers was created by the married couple Carla and Vilhelm Hansen in 1951. Pingo is the penguin, Pelle the pelican and Skæg the seal.

kz-t05u7.p: Which Danish humorist drew tramps, inventions and “flies”?
kz-t05u7.e: Robert Storm Petersen has his own museum in Frederiksberg. His short, dry jokes are known as “flies”.

kz-1hclfao.p: True or false: Albert Einstein failed maths at school.
kz-1hclfao.e: He was excellent at mathematics and had mastered differential calculus by the age of 15. The myth stems partly from a misunderstood grading scale.

kz-cb4mu9.p: What is the name of the main character in “The Legend of Zelda”?
kz-cb4mu9.e: Zelda is the princess. The mix-up is so widespread that it has become a standing joke among players.

kz-1mdy0lf.p: What was Mario's job in his first game, “Donkey Kong” from 1981?
kz-1mdy0lf.e: Back then he was simply called Jumpman. He became a plumber only in “Mario Bros.”, two years later.

kz-1twjpnz.p: Who created Mario, Zelda and Donkey Kong?
kz-1twjpnz.e: Miyamoto has said that Zelda is inspired by his childhood explorations of the woods around Kyoto.

kz-1ym5w6a.e: Pajitnov worked at a Soviet research centre and did not earn a single rouble from the game for the first ten years.

kz-1ipttmm.p: Which company made the Dreamcast console?
kz-1ipttmm.e: The Dreamcast, released in 1998, became Sega's last console. After that the company made only games.

kz-o06pq.p: What was the first arcade game to become a commercial success, in 1972?
kz-o06pq.e: The first machine broke down after a few days – it had been stuffed with coins.

kz-1h6vcqf.p: Which Danish studio is behind the “Hitman” games?
kz-1h6vcqf.e: The Copenhagen studio is also developing a James Bond game.

kz-d4tp7a.e: “Limbo” from 2010 is kept entirely in black and white and has no text or speech.

kz-1d8afqs.p: In which city was the game engine Unity founded in 2004?
kz-1d8afqs.e: Three young developers first made a game that flopped – but the tool they had built became a worldwide success.

kz-1cmc0o5.p: Which city in “Grand Theft Auto” is modelled on Los Angeles?
kz-1cmc0o5.e: Liberty City is New York, Vice City is Miami, and San Fierro is San Francisco.

kz-8wh9wa.e: As long as Sonic has just one ring, he survives a collision.

kz-35m61l.p: What colour is the ghost Blinky in Pac-Man?
kz-35m61l.e: The four ghosts are called Blinky, Pinky, Inky and Clyde, and each chases Pac-Man in its own way.

kz-1ebpwep.p: Which game has the legendary map Dust II?
kz-1ebpwep.e: The map from 2001 has been played so much that fans have recreated it in everything from Minecraft to Fortnite.

kz-uoxp3l.p: Which Danish team won four Major tournaments in Counter-Strike?
kz-uoxp3l.e: Astralis won three Majors in a row in 2018 and 2019, something nobody had done before.

kz-1o6tiyb.p: What reward are you promised in “Portal” – a reward that turns out to be a lie?
kz-1o6tiyb.e: “The cake is a lie” became one of the most quoted phrases in gaming.

kz-1ayyc6m.p: What is the name of the monster hunter in “The Witcher”?
kz-1ayyc6m.e: The games are based on the Polish fantasy novels of Andrzej Sapkowski.

kz-eyp847.p: Which studio is behind “The Last of Us” and “Uncharted”?
kz-eyp847.e: The studio was founded in 1984 but had its big breakthrough with “Crash Bandicoot” in 1996.

kz-lj7jkd.p: What is the currency called in “Fortnite”?
kz-lj7jkd.e: Robux are used in Roblox, Simoleons in The Sims and rupees in Zelda.

kz-ks88a.p: How does the famous Konami code begin?
kz-ks88a.e: The whole code – up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right, B, A – gave 30 lives in “Contra”.

kz-1od3l1y.e: The Atari 2600 came out in 1977, the NES in 1983, the Game Boy in 1989 and the PlayStation in 1994.

kz-g7aacw.p: True or false: Nintendo was founded in 1889.
kz-g7aacw.e: The company made Japanese playing cards in Kyoto and later tried its hand at taxis and instant rice before turning to video games.

kz-1chbjyg.p: True or false: Pac-Man's shape is inspired by a pizza with a slice missing.
kz-1chbjyg.e: The designer Toru Iwatani has said so himself. The name comes from the Japanese onomatopoeia for chomping, paku-paku.

kz-2q2mzr.p: How many players does a handball team have on the court?
kz-2q2mzr.e: Six outfield players and a goalkeeper. Today the goalkeeper may be replaced by a seventh outfield player.

kz-1nl5ulc.p: How high is the basketball hoop?
kz-1nl5ulc.e: The height of ten feet has been the same since the game was invented in 1891.

kz-ye9q1e.p: Which city hosted the first modern Olympic Games in 1896?
kz-ye9q1e.e: 241 athletes from 14 countries took part – all of them men.

kz-1paboxe.p: Which colour is not among the Olympic rings?
kz-1paboxe.e: The rings are blue, yellow, black, green and red. At least one of these colours appears in every country's flag.

kz-1xr8lc9.p: How many points is a touchdown worth in American football?
kz-1xr8lc9.e: Afterwards the team can kick an extra point. A field goal is worth three.

kz-hsmywi.p: What is the highest score possible with three darts?
kz-hsmywi.e: Three darts in treble 20. The centre, the bullseye, scores only 50.

kz-1o1s0n8.p: Which of the four Grand Slam tennis tournaments is played on grass?
kz-1o1s0n8.e: The French Open is played on clay, the other two on hard courts. At Wimbledon, players must also wear white.

kz-139z8hr.p: Who is said to “float like a butterfly and sting like a bee”?
kz-139z8hr.e: Ali won the heavyweight world title three times and lost it for over three years because he refused to fight in Vietnam.

kz-h1wt95.p: Who set the 100 metres world record of 9.58 seconds in 2009?
kz-h1wt95.e: At his fastest, Bolt ran almost 45 kilometres per hour.

kz-182ilpd.p: Which swimmer has won 23 Olympic gold medals – more than anyone else?
kz-182ilpd.e: Were Phelps a country, he would rank in the top 40 on the all-time medal table.

kz-c3cx21.p: Which cycle race is called “A Spring Day in Hell”?
kz-c3cx21.e: The race is ridden over cobblestones in northern France. Jørgen Leth's film from 1976 has the same title.

kz-9tzof1.p: What does the mountains jersey look like in the Tour de France?
kz-9tzof1.e: The green jersey goes to the best sprinter, the white one to the best young rider.

kz-728skc.p: What is a curling stone made of?
kz-728skc.e: Almost all the world's curling stones come from the small Scottish island of Ailsa Craig.

kz-1ch77ko.p: Which sport did James Naismith invent in 1891 using two peach baskets?
kz-1ch77ko.e: In the beginning, the ball had to be fished out with a ladder after every basket – the baskets still had bottoms.

kz-2zgwr9.p: In which sport do England and Australia contest “The Ashes”?
kz-2zgwr9.e: The trophy is a small urn, which reportedly holds the ashes of a burnt cricket stump.

kz-1qjaj6c.p: Which two drivers share the record of seven Formula 1 world championships?
kz-1qjaj6c.e: Michael Schumacher reached seven in 2004, and Lewis Hamilton equalled the record in 2020.

kz-1ck48i1.p: How many players does a rugby union team have on the pitch?
kz-1ck48i1.e: Its sister sport, rugby league, is played with 13 players a side.

kz-6vby2y.p: What is it called when a bowler gets three strikes in a row?
kz-6vby2y.e: In the old days the bowler reportedly won a turkey as a prize. The other three terms belong to golf.

kz-1g43ilh.p: How high is the men's high jump world record?
kz-1g43ilh.e: The record has stood for over 30 years.

kz-172eh34.p: True or false: Golf has been played on the Moon.
kz-172eh34.e: Astronaut Alan Shepard hit two golf balls during the Apollo 14 mission in 1971.

kz-110yxbz.p: True or false: An Olympic gold medal is made of solid gold.
kz-110yxbz.e: The medal is silver with a thin layer of gold. The last time it was made of solid gold was in 1912.

kz-tsiljt.p: How many World Championship titles in a row did the Danish men's handball team win from 2019 to 2025?

kz-tk9rdo.p: Which country was excluded from the 1992 European Football Championship, allowing Denmark to take part?
kz-tk9rdo.e: Yugoslavia was excluded because of the war, ten days before the finals began.

kz-1ys1zpi.p: Who scored Denmark's goals in the 1992 European Championship final against Germany?
kz-1ys1zpi.e: John “Faxe” Jensen hammered the ball into the net, and Vilfort sealed the match at 2-0.

kz-1uhses.p: Who was the national coach when Denmark won the European Championship in 1992?
kz-1uhses.e: By his own account, he was putting in a new kitchen when the news of Denmark's qualification arrived.

kz-1ufgk99.p: How many Olympic golds in a row did the Danish women's handball team win?
kz-1ufgk99.e: In 1996, 2000 and 2004. The final in Athens against South Korea was only decided after two periods of extra time and a penalty shoot-out.

kz-isyfjw.p: Which Danish driver finished on the podium in his first Formula 1 race in 2014?
kz-isyfjw.e: Kevin Magnussen finished second in Australia for McLaren. His father, Jan, raced in Formula 1 himself in the 1990s.

kz-1kkd2vy.p: Which Dane became road cycling world champion in 2019?
kz-1kkd2vy.e: He won in pouring rain in Yorkshire, as the first Dane ever to do so.

kz-wfwc7z.p: Which Dane was captain of Europe's winning Ryder Cup team in 2018?
kz-wfwc7z.e: Europe beat the USA 17½–10½ in Paris.

kz-mqtp6a.p: Which Danish boxer was world champion at super middleweight under the nickname “Viking Warrior”?
kz-mqtp6a.e: Kessler won world titles from several governing bodies and faced, among others, Joe Calzaghe in front of 50,000 spectators.

kz-4nqvxd.p: Which Danish sailor won Olympic gold four times in a row?
kz-4nqvxd.e: Elvstrøm won from 1948 to 1960, and at the age of 60 he competed in his eighth Olympics together with his daughter.

kz-zmm4w2.p: Which Danish swimmer won Olympic gold in the 50 metres freestyle in 2016?
kz-zmm4w2.e: It was Denmark's first Olympic swimming gold since 1948.

kz-s0sk5e.p: Jon Dahl Tomasson shares the record as the national team's top scorer with 52 goals. With whom?
kz-s0sk5e.e: Poul “Tist” Nielsen scored his 52 goals in just 38 internationals between 1910 and 1925.

kz-12zx7au.p: What is Denmark's national stadium called?
kz-12zx7au.e: Parken is located in Østerbro, where the old Idrætsparken once stood, and is the home ground of both the national team and F.C. København.

kz-1o95gm2.p: What was Denmark's lightweight four in rowing nicknamed?
kz-1o95gm2.e: The boat won three Olympic golds. Eskild Ebbesen was in all of them.

kz-18vks2p.p: Which sport made Ole Olsen, Erik Gundersen and Hans Nielsen world champions?
kz-18vks2p.e: Denmark dominated the sport in the 1980s. Between them, the three won ten individual world championships.

kz-183zytx.p: Who became women's singles world champion in badminton on home soil in 1999?
kz-183zytx.e: The final was played in Brøndby Hall. The following year she won Olympic silver in Sydney.

kz-1esxaam.p: Which Danish tennis player rose to number four in the world rankings in 2023?
kz-1esxaam.e: Rune won the Paris Masters in 2022 after beating five top-ten players in a row.

kz-9ohphb.p: True or false: Denmark has never won a medal at a Winter Olympics.
kz-9ohphb.e: The women's curling team won silver at Nagano in 1998 – Denmark's first medal at a Winter Olympics.

kz-199v9gf.p: Which country has won the most men's football World Cups?
kz-199v9gf.e: Brazil has won five times – most recently in 2002.

kz-l3zy7l.p: Who scored the most goals at World Cup finals up to and including 2022?
kz-l3zy7l.e: The German reached 16 goals spread across four tournaments.

kz-3ydfp.p: Which club has won the Champions League the most times?
kz-3ydfp.e: Real Madrid won the first five editions of the tournament, from 1956 to 1960.

kz-1t2df39.p: What is Maradona's goal with his hand against England at the 1986 World Cup called?
kz-1t2df39.e: Four minutes later he dribbled past five Englishmen and scored what was actually voted the goal of the century.

kz-18dl4tw.p: How wide is a football goal?
kz-18dl4tw.e: The dimensions come from the English rules: 8 yards wide and 8 feet high.

kz-25vhnz.p: How far must the wall stand from the ball at a free kick, at minimum?

kz-1seqn39.p: In which year was it banned for the goalkeeper to pick up a back-pass with the hands?
kz-1seqn39.e: The rule was introduced just after the 1992 European Championship, where Denmark had frequently played the ball back to Peter Schmeichel.

kz-yoyxqe.p: Which Dane won the Ballon d'Or as Europe's best football player in 1977?
kz-yoyxqe.e: The small striker from Vejle is still the only Dane to have won the award.

kz-1wrynvb.p: How many Spanish league titles in a row did Michael Laudrup win?
kz-1wrynvb.e: Four with Barcelona and the fifth with arch-rivals Real Madrid.

kz-19ypatv.p: What was the Danish national team nicknamed in the 1980s?
kz-19ypatv.e: The name followed the national team throughout the 1980s.

kz-vz67n1.p: Who scored a hat-trick when Denmark beat Uruguay 6-1 at the 1986 World Cup?
kz-vz67n1.e: The match is regarded as one of the national team's best ever.

kz-129x67v.p: Who has scored the most international goals for men ever?
kz-129x67v.e: The Portuguese overtook Iranian Ali Daei's record of 109 goals in 2021 and remains far ahead.

kz-1q9wf01.p: What is Manchester United's stadium called?
kz-1q9wf01.e: Bobby Charlton gave the stadium the nickname “The Theatre of Dreams”.

kz-1h0wldr.p: Which Italian club is called “The Old Lady”?
kz-1h0wldr.e: The club from Turin plays in black-and-white stripes, originally borrowed from English club Notts County.

kz-csxisy.p: Which country won the women's World Cup in 2023?
kz-csxisy.e: Spain beat England 1-0 in the final in Sydney.

kz-ri33uv.p: In which year did the Danish women's national team reach the European Championship final?
kz-ri33uv.e: Denmark knocked out Germany in the quarter-finals and lost the final 4-2 to the hosts, the Netherlands.

kz-7exn7r.p: How many teams take part in the World Cup finals from 2026 onwards?

o.o1: A soft chip down the middle of the goal
o.o2: A hard shot into the corner
o.o3: A kick with a stop in the run-up
o.o4: A kick with the outside of the foot

kz-f61daj.e: Czechoslovakia's Antonín Panenka decided the 1976 European Championship final that way.

kz-2n9awk.p: Which of these Danish clubs is the oldest?
kz-2n9awk.e: Kjøbenhavns Boldklub dates from 1876 and is regarded as the oldest football club on the European mainland.

kz-mmuwim.p: True or false: You cannot be offside directly from a throw-in.
kz-mmuwim.e: The same applies to goal kicks and corner kicks.

kz-1s8366q.p: Who stole fire from the gods and gave it to humans?
kz-1s8366q.e: As punishment he was chained to a rock, where an eagle pecked at his liver every day.

kz-le1k15.p: What was Achilles' only vulnerable spot?
kz-le1k15.e: His mother dipped him in the river Styx but held him by the heel. Hence the expression “Achilles' heel”.

kz-1okldue.p: Who fell in love with his own reflection?
kz-1okldue.e: He wasted away by the water and turned into a flower – and gave his name to narcissism.

kz-1m1iero.p: Which king wished that everything he touched would turn to gold?
kz-1m1iero.e: The wish became a curse when his food and his daughter also turned to gold.

kz-1xcawp1.p: What is the name of Odysseus' faithful wife?
kz-1xcawp1.e: She kept the suitors at bay by weaving a burial shroud by day and unpicking it at night.

kz-wru5zm.p: Who is the Roman equivalent of Zeus?
kz-wru5zm.e: The Romans took over most of the Greek gods, but gave them new names.

kz-51ndvx.p: How many heads grew out each time Heracles chopped off one of the Hydra's heads?
kz-51ndvx.e: He solved the problem by burning each wound before new heads could grow.

kz-1pcnqbu.p: Who ferries the dead across the river to the underworld?
kz-1pcnqbu.e: The dead were given a coin in their mouth to pay the ferryman.

kz-1waqpo8.p: What did Ariadne give Theseus so he could find his way out of the labyrinth?
kz-1waqpo8.e: This is where the expression “Ariadne's thread” comes from – for whatever helps you find your way.

kz-1hbus7f.p: True or false: Hercules is the hero's Greek name.
kz-1hbus7f.e: The Greeks called him Heracles. Hercules is the Roman form, which Disney among others uses.

kz-pl7ixb.p: What is the name of Thor's hammer?
kz-pl7ixb.e: The hammer always returns to Thor's hand after he has thrown it.

kz-1nuak3j.e: Thor can slaughter and eat the goats in the evening and bring them back to life the next morning.

kz-8bvmuy.e: Freyja also owns a feather cloak, which she can fly in.

kz-144i3ep.p: What are the names of Odin's two ravens?
kz-144i3ep.e: The names mean thought and memory. Geri and Freki are his two wolves.

kz-1s6xn2f.p: Which god is Wednesday named after?
kz-1s6xn2f.e: Tuesday is named after Tyr, Thursday after Thor and Friday after Frigg.

kz-da3tgd.p: What is the name of the serpent that lies around the whole world of humans?
kz-da3tgd.e: The Midgard Serpent is the child of Loki, like the Fenris Wolf and Hel.

kz-1rgq288.p: Where do the fallen warriors go that Freyja chooses?
kz-1rgq288.e: Freyja receives half of the fallen. Only the rest come to Odin in Valhalla.

kz-1ob7ad8.p: What did Odin sacrifice to drink from Mimir's well?
kz-1ob7ad8.e: The well held all wisdom, and the price was an eye.

kz-16hdahf.p: True or false: Thor is the son of Odin.
kz-16hdahf.e: His mother is the giantess Jord.

kz-mqvvm1.p: From which platform does the Hogwarts Express depart?
kz-mqvvm1.e: The platform is at King's Cross in London, where a half-buried luggage trolley is now built into the wall.

kz-1y9isy7.p: What is the core of Harry's wand?
kz-1y9isy7.e: The feather comes from Fawkes – the same bird that gave a feather to Voldemort's wand.

kz-1hjtmp5.p: Which position does Harry play in Quidditch?
kz-1hjtmp5.e: He becomes the youngest Seeker at Hogwarts in a hundred years.

kz-1oqqfoo.p: How many points does catching the Golden Snitch give?
kz-1oqqfoo.e: The catch also ends the match.

kz-1ex4t7j.e: It turns out later that the two had arranged it in advance.

kz-1qlz86d.p: What do Hermione's parents work as?
kz-1qlz86d.e: Both are Muggles with no magical abilities.

kz-1286ld.p: In which year was the first Harry Potter book published in England?
kz-1286ld.e: The first print run was only 500 copies. One of them has since sold for several million kroner.

kz-ondgbr.p: Which Danish brewery has elephants at its gate?
kz-ondgbr.e: The Elephant Gate in Valby was built in 1901. The four granite elephants carry a tower on their backs.

kz-zxzox.p: Which Danish company makes the most jewellery in the world?
kz-zxzox.e: Pandora began as a small goldsmith's shop in Nørrebro in 1982.

kz-y6xz77.p: Which Danish company is behind Ozempic and Wegovy?
kz-y6xz77.e: In 2023 the company became Europe's most valuable company.

kz-itlpq3.p: What do the letters IK in IKEA stand for?

o.o3: The town where the company started

kz-itlpq3.e: Ingvar Kamprad, Elmtaryd, Agunnaryd – the founder's name, the farm and the parish he grew up in.

kz-4fouob.p: Which car brand uses the slogan “Vorsprung durch Technik”?

kz-59fjdd.p: Which soft drink was invented in Nazi Germany when Coca-Cola syrup could not be obtained?
kz-59fjdd.e: The first Fanta, from 1940, was made from whey and apple residue. The name comes from the German word “Fantasie”.

kz-1gdubl6.e: Samsung started in 1938 as a grocery business selling dried fish and noodles.

kz-1umo7hu.p: Which shop chain did Lars Larsen found in 1979?
kz-1umo7hu.e: The first JYSK bedding shop opened in Aarhus. His trademark line became “I've got a good deal”.

kz-1ibgmiv.p: What did Nokia make when the company was founded in 1865?
kz-1ibgmiv.e: The rubber boots and cables came later. Mobile phones first made the company world-famous in the 1990s.

kz-329tx4.p: Which clothing chain did Amancio Ortega found in Galicia in 1975?
kz-329tx4.e: Ortega became one of the world's richest men by getting new collections into the shops within a few weeks.

kz-1eud6rf.p: Which Danish company invented the roof window?
kz-1eud6rf.e: The name is put together from ventilation and lux – the Latin word for light.

kz-1w3ttyb.p: True or false: The name LEGO is a contraction of the Danish words “leg godt” (“play well”).
kz-1w3ttyb.e: Only later did the company discover that “lego” in Latin can mean “I gather”.

kz-1xz4a5l.p: Which car brand has a black rearing horse on a yellow background as its logo?
kz-1xz4a5l.e: The horse was originally painted on an Italian fighter plane from the First World War.

kz-79uyyx.p: Which car brand has a bull in its logo?
kz-79uyyx.e: Ferruccio Lamborghini was born under the sign of Taurus, and several models are named after fighting bulls.

kz-5utylg.p: What do the three points in the Mercedes star stand for?
kz-5utylg.e: Daimler wanted to build engines for vehicles in all three places.

kz-1p1afbc.p: Which company's logo has an arrow going from A to Z like a smile?
kz-1p1afbc.e: The arrow is meant to show that the store sells everything from A to Z.

kz-1rs1lxz.p: Which animal hides in the mountain on Toblerone's classic logo?
kz-1rs1lxz.e: The chocolate comes from Bern, whose coat of arms is a bear.

kz-a6949k.p: Which colour is not in Microsoft's four-square logo?
kz-a6949k.e: The four squares are red, green, blue and yellow.

kz-1pfpamf.p: Which animal appears in Peugeot's logo?
kz-1pfpamf.e: The lion has been used since 1850, when the company made saws – the teeth were meant to be as sharp as a lion's.

kz-13wxtne.p: What do the three wavy lines in the Royal Copenhagen mark represent?

o.o1: The Øresund, Great Belt and Little Belt

kz-13wxtne.e: The waves have been painted under every piece of porcelain since 1775.

kz-awbx1t.p: Which chocolate has a purple cow as its mascot?
kz-awbx1t.e: The cow Lila has featured in the adverts since 1972.

kz-i69pzp.p: What do the stars in Subaru's logo depict?
kz-i69pzp.e: Subaru is the Japanese name for the Pleiades, also known as the Seven Stars.

kz-10dfvin.p: What is Google's parent company called?
kz-10dfvin.e: Alphabet was created in 2015 to bring together Google and the group's more experimental projects.

kz-tku3lv.p: Which Danish company has installed the most wind turbines in the world overall?
kz-tku3lv.e: Vestas began as a smithy in Lem, making farm carts and kitchen machines among other things, before wind turbines came along in 1979.

kz-1h79hnm.p: What was the energy company Ørsted called until 2017?
kz-1h79hnm.e: DONG stood for Dansk Olie og Naturgas (Danish Oil and Natural Gas). The name fit poorly once the company dropped oil and gas.

kz-arrqmv.p: Which Danish company in Bjerringbro is the world's largest pump manufacturer?
kz-arrqmv.e: Poul Due Jensen built his first pump in 1945.

kz-kli4og.p: What did Elon Musk rename Twitter to in 2023?
kz-kli4og.e: The blue bird disappeared from the logo at the same time.

kz-104gb54.e: The app made “to MobilePay” into a verb.

kz-1xprqve.p: Which language has the most native speakers in the world?
kz-1xprqve.e: If you count those who learned the language later, English is the largest.

kz-779plf.p: Which of these languages is Finnish most closely related to?
kz-779plf.e: Finnish, Estonian and – more distantly – Hungarian belong to the Uralic language family and are not Indo-European.

kz-1s5ng2q.p: Which language does the word “robot” come from?
kz-1s5ng2q.e: The word was created for Karel Čapek's play R.U.R. from 1920 and comes from robota, meaning forced labour.

kz-1rajdz8.p: Which of these English words did the Vikings bring to England?
kz-1rajdz8.e: “Window” comes from the Old Norse vindauga, meaning “wind eye”. Sky, egg, knife and husband are also Norse loanwords.

kz-izql6o.e: In Spanish, the tilde turns n into ñ, as in señor.

kz-6at3zw.p: Roughly how many languages are spoken in the world?
kz-6at3zw.e: About 40 per cent of them are endangered and have fewer than a thousand speakers.

kz-31strs.p: Which country has the most languages – over 800?
kz-31strs.e: Mountains and dense jungle have kept the country's many peoples separated for millennia.

kz-6z2q7r.p: Which European language is not related to any other known language?
kz-6z2q7r.e: Basque was spoken in the Pyrenees long before the Indo-European languages arrived in Europe.

kz-1yvacth.p: Who sets the official spelling rules in Denmark?
kz-1yvacth.e: The Danish Language Council publishes Retskrivningsordbogen, the official spelling dictionary that schools and authorities must follow.

kz-sj41sh.p: What does the Latin phrase “carpe diem” mean?
kz-sj41sh.e: The words come from a poem by the Roman poet Horace.

kz-n4d29e.p: True or false: Icelanders can largely read the 13th-century sagas in the original language.
kz-n4d29e.e: The written language has changed so little that modern Icelandic is very close to Old Norse.

kz-83t8bm.p: What is the open sandwich “dyrlægens natmad” (the vet’s midnight snack) made of?

o.o1: Liver pâté, salt meat and sky

kz-83t8bm.e: It is named after a vet who had it every day at the restaurant Oskar Davidsen in Copenhagen.

kz-zwyzl6.e: The raw egg yolk is the sun. The dish comes from Bornholm.

kz-p8wx9v.p: Which dish was chosen as Denmark’s national dish in 2014?
kz-p8wx9v.e: Over 60,000 Danes voted in the poll.

kz-xryjn.p: What is the main ingredient in øllebrød?
kz-xryjn.e: The porridge was invented to use up dry bread scraps, cooked with beer or water.

kz-1w030jr.p: Which small biscuits are served with koldskål?
kz-1w030jr.e: Koldskål is made by stirring together buttermilk, eggs, sugar and lemon.

kz-4jha2l.p: What originally lay inside an æbleskive?
kz-4jha2l.e: Today æbleskiver are almost always made without apple.

kz-2jlbve.e: The tins bulge from the fermentation, and the smell is so strong that they are best opened outdoors.

kz-1i4k4m9.p: What is the Icelandic speciality hákarl?
kz-1i4k4m9.e: Greenland shark meat is poisonous when fresh, so it must ferment and hang for months before it can be eaten.

kz-a9oyrc.e: At many Swedish workplaces, fika twice a day is almost sacred.

kz-1qrihb7.p: Which restaurant in Copenhagen has been named the world’s best five times?
kz-1qrihb7.e: The name blends the Danish words for “Nordic” and “food”.

kz-qjkf8e.p: Who co-founded Noma with René Redzepi?
kz-qjkf8e.e: Meyer was also the driving force behind the New Nordic Cuisine manifesto in 2004.

kz-o2p1ya.p: Which Danish chef has won gold, silver and bronze at the Bocuse d’Or?
kz-o2p1ya.e: His restaurant Geranium was named the world’s best in 2022.

kz-1oj390q.p: Which herb is used in gravad laks?
kz-1oj390q.e: “Gravad” means buried: originally the fish was salted and buried in sand.

kz-1ry5ulm.p: What is the lingonberry called in Swedish?
kz-1ry5ulm.e: Hjortron is cloudberry, and smultron is wild strawberry.

kz-1ibcijr.p: What is a flødebolle filled with?
kz-1ibcijr.e: Despite the name, there is no cream in a flødebolle.

kz-9q57gn.p: Which cold cut is made from a rolled pork shoulder seasoned with spices and pressed?
kz-9q57gn.e: Rullepølse is boiled and then pressed, so it can be cut into thin slices.

kz-19xv6h4.p: What gives Danish remoulade its yellow colour?
kz-19xv6h4.e: The French original is white. The Danish version with curry and turmeric is our own.

kz-ywqbef.e: The dish is Norway’s national dish and has its own festival day on the last Thursday of September.

kz-1ljiwih.p: True or false: Wienerbrød came to Denmark with bakers from Vienna.
kz-1ljiwih.e: During a bakers’ strike in 1850, the masters fetched journeymen from Austria. Abroad, the pastry is known as “Danish”.

kz-1sw0ar5.p: What does the word “sushi” actually mean?
kz-1sw0ar5.e: It is the vinegared rice that makes a dish sushi. Raw fish alone is called sashimi.

kz-wvevo3.p: What is the “wasabi” served at most restaurants outside Japan?
kz-wvevo3.e: Real wasabi is expensive and loses its flavour within fifteen minutes, so most places serve horseradish coloured green.

kz-1qeyuc8.p: Which city does pizza Margherita come from?
kz-1qeyuc8.e: According to the story, it was made for Queen Margherita in 1889 in the colours of the Italian flag.

kz-o57xk4.p: What is not in a classic Roman carbonara?
kz-o57xk4.e: The creamy texture comes from eggs and cheese, stirred together with a little pasta water.

kz-18omjk3.p: What is the world’s most expensive spice?
kz-18omjk3.e: Each crocus has only three stigmas, which are picked by hand. It takes about 150,000 flowers to make a kilo.

kz-vi62uu.p: What kind of plant does vanilla come from?
kz-vi62uu.e: Outside Mexico each flower must be pollinated by hand, because the insect that does it in nature is found only there.

kz-1xxnjxu.p: Which country does the noodle soup pho come from?
kz-1xxnjxu.e: The soup is especially eaten for breakfast and is cooked with beef, star anise and ginger.

kz-hrm7vg.p: Which nuts are used in a classic pesto?
kz-hrm7vg.e: Pesto alla genovese is also made from basil, garlic, Parmesan, pecorino and olive oil.

kz-zbolur.p: Which fish is in Worcestershire sauce?
kz-zbolur.e: The sauce is fermented for months, which is why it is not vegetarian.

kz-1dsodmx.p: Where does the kiwifruit originally come from?
kz-1dsodmx.e: It was called Chinese gooseberry until New Zealand growers renamed it in 1959.

kz-1antztt.p: Which continent does the potato come from?
kz-1antztt.e: The potato was grown in the Andes for thousands of years before the Spanish brought it to Europe.

kz-kt09cq.p: What does the Scoville scale measure?
kz-kt09cq.e: A jalapeño reaches a few thousand on the scale, while the hottest chillies exceed two million.

kz-nnlmad.p: What is the Korean national dish kimchi made from?
kz-nnlmad.e: Korea’s national dish is mainly made from Chinese cabbage with chilli, garlic and ginger.

kz-20lmv3.p: What is halloumi particularly known for?

o.o1: It does not melt when fried
o.o2: It has no salt at all
o.o3: It is aged for ten years
o.o4: It is made from camel milk

kz-20lmv3.e: The cheese from Cyprus has a high melting point, so it can be grilled in slices.

kz-14aqs79.p: True or false: Caesar salad is named after Julius Caesar.
kz-14aqs79.e: It was created by the restaurateur Caesar Cardini in Tijuana, Mexico, in 1924.

kz-1h8062f.p: True or false: Peanuts are botanically nuts.
kz-1h8062f.e: They are legumes and belong to the same family as peas and beans. The pods ripen underground.

kz-1lk5s7k.p: What is the French biscuit made of two almond meringues with cream in between called?
kz-1lk5s7k.e: A makron is the Danish coconut cake. The names look alike, but the cakes are not.

kz-17psf4a.p: Which cake do Danes traditionally eat on New Year’s Eve?
kz-17psf4a.e: Kransekage is made from marzipan, sugar and egg whites, and is built up as a tower of rings.

kz-oout2.p: Which region of Denmark does brunsviger come from?
kz-oout2.e: On Funen it is also baked as a “kagemand” and “kagekone” (cake man and cake woman) for birthdays.

kz-192izg5.p: What is the minimum number of cakes that belongs on a proper South Jutland coffee table?
kz-192izg5.e: Seven soft and seven hard – and guests are expected to try them all.

o.o2: Eggs and cream whipped light and airy
o.o3: Flour and water boiled into a cream

kz-odfl57.e: The word sounds French, but it is Danish baking jargon and is not known in France.

kz-16j8dbw.p: At what temperature does yeast die?
kz-16j8dbw.e: Yeast thrives best at 30–37 degrees. That is why the liquid should only be lukewarm, just warm enough for a little finger.

kz-11u7bk6.p: Which cake is named after a Russian ballerina?
kz-11u7bk6.e: The meringue cake was created in honour of Anna Pavlova. Australia and New Zealand still argue over who invented it.

kz-3je6m9.p: Who is the Sarah Bernhardt cake named after?
kz-3je6m9.e: The cake was created by a Copenhagen confectioner when the French diva visited the city in 1911.

kz-1ehjn1e.p: What is a napoleonshat filled with?
kz-1ehjn1e.e: The shortcrust pastry is folded around a marzipan ball, so the cake looks like a three-cornered hat.

kz-k9pcu0.p: What is the dough for cream puffs and éclairs called in French?
kz-k9pcu0.e: Choux means cabbage – the little buns look like cabbage heads.

kz-1iux8dv.p: Which flour is traditionally used for dried Italian pasta?
kz-1iux8dv.e: Durum is a hard wheat variety with a lot of protein, which gives pasta its bite.

kz-1ox28r.p: Which cake consists of two layers of shortcrust with raspberry jam in between and icing on top?
kz-1ox28r.e: The raspberry slice is among the best-selling cakes at Danish bakers.

kz-qpuwt6.p: What happens to yeast dough if you forget the salt?

o.o2: It does not rise at all

kz-qpuwt6.e: Salt slows the yeast and tightens the gluten network. Without salt the dough rises uncontrollably and easily collapses.

kz-ptug8l.p: What is it called when dough rises slowly in the fridge overnight?
kz-ptug8l.e: The long rising time gives more flavour and a dough that is easier to shape.

kz-3didaa.p: Which berry gives gin its flavour?
kz-3didaa.e: The name gin comes from the Dutch “jenever”, which means juniper.

kz-1qlxejj.p: What is the bitter flavouring in tonic water?
kz-1qlxejj.e: British colonists in India drank quinine against malaria and mixed it with gin to make it easier to get down.

kz-shqtnt.p: Which country does the sparkling wine cava come from?
kz-shqtnt.e: Most cava is made in Catalonia using the same method as champagne.

kz-hwmm4c.p: Which spirit is the base of a Cosmopolitan?
kz-hwmm4c.e: The drink is also mixed with cranberry juice, orange liqueur and lime.

kz-1rcggs.p: Which cocktail is made from rum, coconut cream and pineapple juice?
kz-1rcggs.e: The name means strained pineapple. The drink is Puerto Rico’s national drink.

kz-1dyhr2o.p: Which spirit is used in a Caipirinha?
kz-1dyhr2o.e: Cachaça is distilled from fresh sugar cane juice, while rum is usually made from molasses.

kz-1y8waki.e: The agave is not a cactus, but is related to asparagus.

kz-474muq.p: How long must Scotch whisky be matured in cask at minimum?
kz-474muq.e: The maturing must take place in oak casks in Scotland.

kz-1d7lly2.p: Which grain must make up the largest share of bourbon?
kz-1d7lly2.e: At least 51 per cent maize, and the whiskey must be aged in new, charred oak casks.

kz-1opjysb.p: Which spice must dominate an akvavit?
kz-1opjysb.e: According to EU rules, akvavit must taste of caraway or dill.

kz-1xbhjgw.p: What does the abbreviation IPA stand for?
kz-1xbhjgw.e: The beer was brewed extra strong and with extra hops so that it could survive the sea voyage to India.

kz-1n9sjse.p: What type of beer is a pilsner?
kz-1n9sjse.e: Bottom yeast works in the cold and sinks to the bottom. Ale, wheat beer and stout are top-fermented.

kz-toy5jb.p: In which country is the city of Plzeň, which the pilsner is named after, located?
kz-toy5jb.e: The first golden pilsner was brewed there in 1842.

o.o1: The Christmas beer hits the shops

kz-dr6tk8.e: Tuborg’s Christmas brew is launched on the first Friday in November with snow and elf hats – J-Day was introduced in 1990.

kz-157cton.p: What does “brut” mean on a bottle of champagne?
kz-157cton.e: The driest type is called brut nature, and the sweet type is called doux.

kz-1suy295.p: How much does a magnum bottle hold?
kz-1suy295.e: That is two ordinary bottles. A jeroboam is twice the size of a magnum.

kz-vjy0sq.e: The spirit stops the fermentation, so some of the grapes’ sweetness remains.

kz-h1opa1.p: What colour are the grapes in a “blanc de noirs”?
kz-h1opa1.e: The juice from blue grapes is pale. The wine only turns red if the skins are left to stay in contact with it.

kz-qgoa50.p: True or false: Alcohol warms the body when it is cold.
kz-qgoa50.e: Alcohol widens the blood vessels in the skin, so you feel warm – but the body loses heat faster.

kz-3tjesq.p: Which currency is the Danish krone pegged to?
kz-3tjesq.e: The fixed-exchange-rate policy has kept the rate largely unchanged since 1982 – first against the Deutschmark, then against the euro.

kz-1owkg2c.p: What is the standard Danish VAT rate?
kz-1owkg2c.e: Danish VAT is among the highest in the world and applies to almost all goods.

kz-x3rn7g.p: Which Danish banknote became invalid in every series in 2025?
kz-x3rn7g.e: The large note was used so little in everyday life – and so much in crime – that the Danish National Bank withdrew it.

kz-1fieviy.p: What is the smallest coin you can pay with in Denmark?

kz-1c6uklu.e: The name comes from the city of Florence, where the gold coin the fiorino was minted.

kz-122pyke.e: The dong is used in Vietnam, the ringgit in Malaysia and the rupiah in Indonesia.

kz-8xk0vo.e: The real was introduced in 1994 to stop inflation of over 2,000 per cent a year.

kz-3zhayg.p: What is a market called where share prices rise over a long period?
kz-3zhayg.e: The bull thrusts upwards, while the bear strikes downwards. A bear market is therefore a falling market.

kz-17y64i5.p: What is the name of the Danish elite share index?
kz-17y64i5.e: The index covers the 25 most traded shares on the Copenhagen stock exchange.

kz-sitwah.p: What is the Big Mac index used to compare?
kz-sitwah.e: The magazine The Economist has used the price of the burger in different countries as a half-serious yardstick since 1986.

kz-1b5e2i5.p: Who described the market’s “invisible hand” in 1776?
kz-1b5e2i5.e: “The Wealth of Nations” is regarded as the basic textbook of modern economics.

kz-k28gcd.p: About how many years does it take to double savings at 7 per cent interest a year?
kz-k28gcd.e: The rule of thumb is the 72 rule: divide 72 by the interest rate, and you get the number of years.

kz-1x8fm9o.e: It sounds nice, but it makes consumers postpone purchases and can bring the economy to a standstill.

kz-1dwgtf9.p: What is the tax called that is levied on goods such as cigarettes, alcohol and petrol?
kz-1dwgtf9.e: The duty is levied on certain goods – often to limit consumption.

kz-b4t797.p: Which commodity triggered a famous speculative bubble in the Netherlands in the 1630s?
kz-b4t797.e: At the peak, a single rare bulb could cost as much as a house on a canal in Amsterdam.

kz-12ygx0d.p: What is the name of the unknown person or group who created bitcoin?
kz-12ygx0d.e: No one knows who is hiding behind the name. That person is believed to own around a million bitcoin that have never been moved.

kz-1svqehs.p: Which Danish payment card was launched in 1983?
kz-1svqehs.e: In the first years the card was run through a manual imprinter, a “fluesmækker” (fly swatter), that made an impression on paper.

kz-o87qnt.p: Who is pictured on the American one-dollar bill?
kz-o87qnt.e: Lincoln is on the five-dollar bill and Franklin on the hundred-dollar bill.

o.o1: A market with a few large sellers
o.o2: A market with only one seller
o.o3: A market with only one buyer

kz-zhc7o6.e: The Danish grocery market and mobile market are typical examples.

kz-1bgg5yb.p: What is the tendency called to notice especially what confirms one’s own view?
kz-1bgg5yb.e: We search for, remember and believe most easily what fits with what we already think.

kz-fqtemn.p: What does the Dunning-Kruger effect show?

o.o1: The least skilled overestimate themselves the most
o.o2: The most skilled work the slowest
o.o4: Experience makes people more willing to take risks

kz-fqtemn.e: Those who lack knowledge also lack the skills needed to notice it.

kz-527jnv.p: What did Stanley Milgram’s experiments with electric shocks in 1961 show?

o.o1: People obey authority to an extreme degree

kz-527jnv.e: Two-thirds of the participants gave what they believed were life-threatening shocks because the experimenter told them to carry on.

kz-13y95nh.p: What did Solomon Asch’s experiments with lines of different length show?

o.o1: Group pressure makes people answer wrongly
o.o4: Children see more accurately than adults

kz-13y95nh.e: When everyone else in the room gave obviously wrong answers, three out of four participants went along with them at least once.

kz-1rgn7sk.p: What does the bystander effect hold?

o.o1: The more witnesses, the fewer people intervene
o.o2: The more spectators, the better the performance
o.o3: The bigger the audience, the more nervous people become
o.o4: The more participants, the more disagreement

kz-1rgn7sk.e: Everyone assumes someone else will act. It helps to point at one specific person and ask for help.

kz-1b3bsuy.p: What gave its name to Stockholm syndrome?

o.o1: A bank robbery with hostages in 1973
o.o2: The diary of a Swedish psychiatrist

kz-1b3bsuy.e: The hostages afterwards defended the robbers and refused to testify against them.

kz-10fan6h.e: Fear of open spaces and crowds is called agoraphobia.

kz-1sevs59.p: What is it called when one good trait makes us think well of everything about a person?
kz-1sevs59.e: Attractive people, for example, are more often judged to be clever and honest.

o.o1: The feeling of being a fraud
o.o4: The habit of lying about small things

kz-teua1y.e: The phenomenon was described in 1978 and is especially widespread among highly educated people.

kz-buscx8.p: In which sleep stage do we have most of our dreams, and the most vivid ones?
kz-buscx8.e: REM stands for rapid eye movement. The eyes move quickly while the body’s muscles are paralysed.

kz-1sad8p3.p: What were the children supposed to resist in the famous marshmallow test?
kz-1sad8p3.e: Those who waited got two. The experiment from the 1960s is about the ability to postpone needs.

kz-1xdx1zo.e: It is the evil twin of the placebo effect: those who expect side effects get them more often.

kz-1oqxvq2.e: Freud worked in Vienna and had his patients lie on a couch and speak freely.

kz-ptbnxv.p: What did Freud call the part of the psyche that contains the drives?
kz-ptbnxv.e: The ego negotiates between the id’s desires and the superego’s morality. The shadow is Jung’s concept.

kz-wr5xpl.p: Who introduced the concepts of introversion and extraversion?
kz-wr5xpl.e: Jung also wrote about the collective unconscious and archetypes.

kz-1195b1w.p: What is at the top of Maslow’s hierarchy of needs?
kz-1195b1w.e: Maslow never drew a pyramid himself – it came into the textbooks later.

kz-1u9lrmi.p: Which Swiss psychologist described children’s thinking in four stages?
kz-1u9lrmi.e: Piaget based much of his theory on observing his own three children.

kz-gf6s20.p: What did Mihály Csíkszentmihályi call the state of being completely absorbed in a task?
kz-gf6s20.e: Flow arises when the task is hard enough to challenge you, but not so hard that you give up.

kz-hzn6yv.p: Which stage comes first in Kübler-Ross’s model of grief?
kz-hzn6yv.e: Anger, bargaining, depression and acceptance follow. The model is widely used but controversial.

kz-1kcem64.p: What did Harry Harlow’s experiments with baby monkeys show?

o.o1: They preferred a soft mother to food
o.o2: They learned fastest from older monkeys
o.o3: They recognised themselves in a mirror

kz-1kcem64.e: The young clung to the cloth doll and only went to the wire mother to feed.

o.o1: Giving up because nothing has helped
o.o3: Pretending to be weak to get help

kz-1ck82jz.e: Martin Seligman described the phenomenon in 1967 and later linked it to depression.

kz-1mkxrvf.p: Who led the Stanford prison experiment in 1971?
kz-1mkxrvf.e: Students were randomly assigned as prisoners and guards. The experiment was stopped after six days and has since been heavily criticised.

kz-1d3vnfo.p: What is the answer to “life, the universe and everything” in The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy?
kz-1d3vnfo.e: The supercomputer Deep Thought spends seven and a half million years working it out – but nobody knows what the question is.

kz-197fi2t.p: What does the trolley problem ask?

o.o1: Whether one may be sacrificed to save five
o.o2: Whether one may lie to spare a friend
o.o4: Whether the majority is always right

kz-197fi2t.e: A runaway tram is heading towards five people. You can switch tracks so that it hits only one. Would you?

o.o1: It is wisest to believe in God

kz-1d39bkz.e: If you are wrong, you lose a little. If you are right, you win everything.

kz-1jklzqj.p: What is Plato’s allegory of the cave a picture of?
kz-1jklzqj.e: The prisoners in the cave see only shadows on the wall and think that is the whole world.

o.o1: Where are all the other civilisations?
o.o2: Light is both wave and particle
o.o3: You cannot meet yourself in time

kz-17k7ccr.e: The physicist Enrico Fermi asked over lunch in 1950: “Where is everybody?”

o.o1: The simplest explanation is usually right
o.o2: Anything that can go wrong will go wrong
o.o3: Every action has an opposite reaction

kz-c0m0j2.e: If you hear hoofbeats, think of horses – not zebras.

kz-1ev5t9q.e: The reminder has shaped art for centuries, with skulls, hourglasses and withered flowers.

kz-1klws2x.p: What was Socrates, by his own account, certain of?

o.o4: That the gods do not exist

kz-1klws2x.e: The oracle at Delphi had called him the wisest. He concluded this must be because he knew his own ignorance.

kz-8f7vaf.p: Which philosopher declared that “God is dead”?
kz-8f7vaf.e: He did not mean that a god had died, but that belief had lost its power as the foundation of morality.

kz-a1wr8j.p: Which of these is not one of Kierkegaard’s three stages?
kz-a1wr8j.e: The aesthete pursues pleasure, the ethical person chooses duty, and the religious person takes the leap of faith.

kz-1m2cp5f.p: What does the “brain in a vat” thought experiment ask?

o.o1: Whether we can know the world is real
o.o2: Whether consciousness can be moved to a machine
o.o3: Whether the brain can live without a body
o.o4: Whether thoughts can be measured physically

kz-1m2cp5f.e: The idea is the basis for the film “The Matrix”.

kz-etjl7v.p: Which Hungarian toy became a worldwide craze in 1980?
kz-etjl7v.e: The architect Ernő Rubik himself needed a month to solve it the first time.

kz-tjz7yc.p: Which 1985 film sends Marty McFly 30 years back in time?
kz-tjz7yc.e: The time machine was first meant to be a fridge. It became a DeLorean.

kz-u9yo41.p: Who was shot outside his home in New York in December 1980?
kz-u9yo41.e: Lennon was killed by a man he had given an autograph to just hours earlier.

kz-x5yiol.p: Which Norwegian band had a hit with “Take On Me” and an animated video?
kz-x5yiol.e: The video mixed film and pencil drawing and took four months to make.

kz-ii4tx8.p: What was Denmark’s fan song for the 1986 World Cup in Mexico called?

o.o3: Big Boys in Red and White

kz-ii4tx8.e: The title plays on the name of coach Sepp Piontek. The song became a big hit during that summer’s Mexico fever.

kz-19yxy0v.p: Who was US president for most of the 1980s?
kz-19yxy0v.e: The former film actor served from 1981 to 1989.

kz-1c0v5h2.p: Which disease got its name in 1982?
kz-1c0v5h2.e: The virus itself, HIV, was not identified until the following year.

kz-fopn03.p: Which Dane came second in the 1985 vote for Europe’s best footballer?
kz-fopn03.e: Elkjær had just made Verona Italian champions – and scored a famous goal in his stocking socks.

kz-t10su2.p: In which year was Germany reunified?
kz-t10su2.e: The Wall fell in November 1989, and on 3 October 1990 the country was one again.

kz-tuy9h9.p: Who was released in 1990 after 27 years in prison?
kz-tuy9h9.e: Four years later he became South Africa’s first Black president.

kz-1xmgf7l.p: Which British princess died in a car crash in Paris in 1997?
kz-1xmgf7l.e: Over two billion people are estimated to have watched the funeral on television.

kz-cuo43s.p: Which girl group had a hit with “Wannabe” in 1996?
kz-cuo43s.e: The debut single went to number one in 37 countries.

kz-8w4i72.p: What was feared would hit the world’s computers at New Year’s 1999?
kz-8w4i72.e: Many old systems stored only the last two digits of the year. Billions were spent fixing it – and the night passed quietly.

kz-12gi2kv.p: Which console did Sony release in 1994?
kz-12gi2kv.e: It began as a CD drive for Nintendo. When the partnership collapsed, Sony made its own machine.

kz-75mhvb.p: Which operating system introduced the Start button?
kz-75mhvb.e: The launch was accompanied by the Rolling Stones song “Start Me Up”.

kz-rlhd66.p: Which team did Denmark lose 2–3 to in the quarter-finals of the 1998 World Cup?
kz-rlhd66.e: Shortly before, Denmark had beaten Nigeria 4–1 in what many regard as the national team’s best World Cup match.

kz-wfepsp.p: Which boy band consisted of Nick, Brian, AJ, Howie and Kevin?
kz-wfepsp.e: With over 100 million records sold, the group is the best-selling boy band of all time.

kz-jrh123.p: Which Friday show on TV 2 did Ole Stephensen host from 1988?
kz-jrh123.e: The show ran from the channel’s launch in 1988 until 1996.

kz-1xi3dp8.e: The invasion triggered the Gulf War, in which a US-led coalition liberated Kuwait in 1991.

kz-1xjd4kw.p: Which country peacefully split in two on 1 January 1993?
kz-1xjd4kw.e: The split into the Czech Republic and Slovakia is known as the Velvet Divorce.

kz-wih01t.p: Which 1994 Christmas calendar introduced the mischievous elf Pyrus?
kz-wih01t.e: Pyrus travels through Danish history together with the National Archivist, Bertramsen.

kz-1mg5zav.p: Which Los del Río song became a worldwide dance craze in 1996?
kz-1mg5zav.e: The song spent 14 weeks at number one in the United States.

kz-19w2vfe.p: True or false: The first text message, sent in 1992, read “Merry Christmas”.
kz-19w2vfe.e: It was sent from a computer to a mobile phone. The recipient could not reply, because the phone had no keyboard for it.

kz-11y1pdo.p: Which Danish newspaper printed the Muhammad cartoons in 2005?
kz-11y1pdo.e: The cartoons triggered the biggest foreign policy crisis for Denmark since the Second World War.

kz-vzvc9m.p: Which year did the tsunami hit the Indian Ocean on Boxing Day?
kz-vzvc9m.e: Around 230,000 people in 14 countries lost their lives.

kz-5abup0.p: Which climate summit was held in Copenhagen in 2009?
kz-5abup0.e: Expectations were enormous, but the meeting ended without a binding agreement. That came only in Paris six years later.

kz-yfnnwi.p: Which Danish duo hit the world with “Move Your Feet” in 2002?
kz-yfnnwi.e: The video, in crude pixel graphics, became a classic on MTV.

kz-1hn18tg.p: Which social network was the world’s largest before Facebook overtook it in 2008?
kz-1hn18tg.e: Every new user was automatically made friends with co-founder Tom.

kz-1pyu831.p: What was the Danish network that most teenagers had a profile on in the mid-2000s?
kz-1pyu831.e: Arto had a guestbook, profile text and flashing images and was the teenagers' meeting place.

kz-ingntb.p: Who wrote the bestseller “The Da Vinci Code”?
kz-ingntb.e: The novel from 2003 has sold over 80 million copies.

kz-1jsneri.p: Which disease broke out in West Africa in 2014?
kz-1jsneri.e: Over 11,000 people died, especially in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone.

kz-1oypq1u.p: Which movement spread in 2017 after the allegations against film producer Harvey Weinstein?
kz-1oypq1u.e: The term had already been used by activist Tarana Burke in 2006.

kz-1kyt7gx.p: Which Swedish teenager began a school strike for the climate in 2018?
kz-1kyt7gx.e: She sat alone in front of the Riksdag with a sign. The following year, millions of students struck around the world.

kz-usnhyv.p: Which church in Paris burned in April 2019?
kz-usnhyv.e: The spire collapsed in front of live cameras. The church reopened in December 2024.

kz-1a2x1cb.p: What was the name of the giraffe that was put down at Copenhagen Zoo in 2014?
kz-1a2x1cb.e: The killing and the public dissection went around the world and triggered protests in many countries.

kz-1poy3bv.p: On which date in 2020 did the prime minister shut Denmark down because of corona?
kz-1poy3bv.e: The evening press conference sent schoolchildren and public employees home with a few days' notice.

kz-qo0d1n.p: Which animal was culled in the millions in Denmark in 2020?
kz-qo0d1n.e: About 15 million mink were culled out of fear of a corona mutation. The order turned out to lack a legal basis.

kz-1ot2ujy.p: What was the name of the container ship that blocked the Suez Canal for six days in 2021?
kz-1ot2ujy.e: The 400-metre ship wedged itself across the canal and held back goods worth billions every day.

kz-3grq3m.p: Which gas pipelines were blown up in the Baltic Sea in September 2022?
kz-3grq3m.e: The explosions took place near Bornholm in international waters.

kz-1xuni9m.p: Which chatbot did OpenAI launch in November 2022?
kz-1xuni9m.e: It reached a hundred million users in two months – faster than any app before it.

kz-1i7moqm.p: Which two films created the “Barbenheimer” phenomenon in the summer of 2023?
kz-1i7moqm.e: The two very different films premiered on the same day, and many people watched them one right after the other.

kz-1l00nrp.p: What is the name of the space telescope launched on Christmas Day 2021?
kz-1l00nrp.e: The telescope sees in infrared light and can therefore look further back in the history of the universe than any before it.

kz-1n8budg.p: Which public holiday was abolished in Denmark from 2024?
kz-1n8budg.e: The abolition was meant to raise money for defence and triggered large protests.

kz-1usts3c.p: Which country won the 2021 European Football Championship?
kz-1usts3c.e: Italy beat England on penalties at Wembley. Denmark reached the semi-finals.

kz-5hh76n.p: What is the name of Meta's text-based rival to X from 2023?
kz-5hh76n.e: The app had a hundred million sign-ups in five days.

kz-1pyshai.p: What is being built under the Fehmarn Belt between Lolland and Germany?
kz-1pyshai.e: The 18-kilometre tunnel is assembled from concrete elements cast in Rødbyhavn and lowered into a trench on the seabed.

kz-1q1bsti.p: What is the name of the artificial peninsula being built off Copenhagen?
kz-1q1bsti.e: The peninsula is planned to protect the city from storm surges and also to make room for a new district.

kz-17xuyb6.p: Which singer staged “The Eras Tour” in 2023 and 2024?
kz-17xuyb6.e: The tour became the first ever to sell tickets worth over two billion dollars.

kz-9h9cfx.p: Who became British king when Queen Elizabeth died in 2022?
kz-9h9cfx.e: He was 73 years old and the oldest ever to take over the British throne.

kz-1w1bbi.p: Which event from the 2020s came first?

o.o1: The United Kingdom left the EU

kz-1w1bbi.e: Brexit took effect in January 2020, the invasion came in February 2022, ChatGPT in November 2022, and the accession in January 2024.

kz-9btiyb.p: Which letter is not used in the name of any of the 50 US states?
kz-9btiyb.e: J is in New Jersey, X in Texas and Z in Arizona. Only Q is missing altogether.

kz-1dn09l7.p: How many of the piano's 88 keys are black?
kz-1dn09l7.e: The 52 white keys are the natural notes. The black keys sit in groups of two and three.

kz-gwmv9f.e: The rock skerry Østerskær in the Ertholmene island group lies 18 kilometres north-east of Bornholm.

kz-1c0fra1.p: Who became head of government at the 1901 change of system?
kz-1c0fra1.e: Law professor Deuntzer led the first Venstre (Liberal) government. J.C. Christensen was the government's strong man and took over the post in 1905.

kz-1yjwn6g.p: Which principle took hold at the 1901 change of system?
kz-1yjwn6g.e: From then on, a government could not stay in office against a majority in the Folketing (the Danish parliament). The principle only entered the Danish Constitution in 1953.

kz-fp6ry2.p: How many of the Folketing's 175 Danish seats are constituency seats?
kz-fp6ry2.e: The last 40 are top-up seats, which ensure that parties get seats in proportion to their total vote.

kz-7tcb36.p: Which country has twice voted no to membership of the EC and the EU?
kz-7tcb36.e: Norwegians said no in both 1972 and 1994 – both times by a narrow majority.

kz-8dl1qn.p: How many countries took part in founding the UN in 1945?
kz-8dl1qn.e: Denmark was one of them. Today the UN has 193 member states.

kz-xeqtr0.p: Which doctrine from 1947 promised American support to countries threatened by communism?
kz-xeqtr0.e: It was formulated to help Greece and Turkey and is regarded as the beginning of the Cold War.

kz-1v18mq0.p: Which treaty ended the Thirty Years' War in 1648?
kz-1v18mq0.e: The treaty established that states decide over their own territory – the foundation of the modern state system.

kz-1jpycr1.p: What did Denmark lose at the Peace of Roskilde in 1658?
kz-1jpycr1.e: The Swedes had crossed the ice over the Belts. Bornholm and the Trondhjem len were also lost, but came back two years later.

kz-17orlvy.p: Which king was killed at Finderup Lade in 1286?
kz-17orlvy.e: He received 56 stab wounds. It is the most recent regicide in Danish history, and the perpetrators have never been found with certainty.

kz-1qx6pej.p: Who was the last emperor of the Western Roman Empire?
kz-1qx6pej.e: The young emperor was deposed by the Germanic chieftain Odoacer in 476. Ironically, he was named after both Rome's founder and its first emperor.

kz-wlf0fj.p: Which country was the first to ban the transatlantic slave trade?
kz-wlf0fj.e: The ban was adopted in 1792 but only came into force in 1803. Slavery itself in the Danish West Indies continued until 1848.

kz-4ickjp.p: What is the name of the deepest point in the world's oceans?
kz-4ickjp.e: It lies in the Mariana Trench in the Pacific Ocean, just under 11 kilometres below the surface.

kz-1gyje88.p: Which major river crosses the equator twice?
kz-1gyje88.e: The river makes a large bend to the north. Because it gets rain from both sides of the equator, it has water all year round.

kz-1xp6zpz.p: What is the capital of Burkina Faso?
kz-1xp6zpz.e: Bamako is in Mali, Niamey in Niger and N'Djamena in Chad.

kz-14j8yjf.p: Which two countries share the world's longest land border?
kz-14j8yjf.e: The border is 8,891 kilometres long when Alaska is included.

kz-66w0ch.p: Which particle was nicknamed “the God particle”?
kz-66w0ch.e: It gives other particles their mass and was detected at CERN in 2012. The physicists themselves do not like the nickname.

o.o1: The number of particles in a mole
o.o2: The speed of light in a vacuum

kz-1ti2tk2.e: The number is about 6 followed by 23 zeros.

kz-66np10.p: Which Dane discovered in 1936 that the Earth has a solid inner core?
kz-66np10.e: The seismologist read it from earthquake waves that were bent in a way a liquid core could not explain.

kz-v9t2hi.p: Which Danish scientist founded geology and ended up as a Catholic bishop?
kz-v9t2hi.e: Steno showed that rock layers are deposited on top of each other in chronological order. He was beatified by the pope in 1988.

kz-4jjpx7.p: Which planet has the shortest day in the solar system?
kz-4jjpx7.e: The giant planet rotates once in under ten hours.

kz-i6sbab.p: What is the boundary at 100 kilometres altitude, where space is considered to begin, called?
kz-i6sbab.e: Up here the air is so thin that an aircraft would have to fly faster than orbital speed to get lift.

kz-1gxjpxj.p: Which star is the closest to the Sun after the Sun itself?
kz-1gxjpxj.e: Its light takes 4.2 years to reach us.

kz-2tc6wr.p: Which browser from 1993 made the internet popular by showing images and text together?
kz-2tc6wr.e: The people behind Mosaic made Netscape the following year.

kz-2cwwvp.p: Which Dane helped found Skype in 2003?
kz-2cwwvp.e: He founded the service together with the Swede Niklas Zennström. Two years later it was sold to eBay for 2.6 billion dollars.

kz-11bml4a.p: What does the abbreviation HTTP stand for?
kz-11bml4a.e: The protocol describes how a browser asks a server for a page.

kz-1yo2eyd.p: What is the tendency to remember unfinished tasks better than finished ones called?
kz-1yo2eyd.e: The psychologist Bluma Zeigarnik got the idea in a café, where the waiters only remembered the orders that had not yet been paid.

kz-7c3t73.p: What does the Flynn effect show?

o.o1: That IQ scores rose through the 1900s
o.o2: That memory peaks in one's twenties

kz-7c3t73.e: The average rose by about three points per decade. In several Western countries, including Denmark, the rise has since levelled off.

kz-1il259d.p: Which Greek philosopher is said to have lived in a barrel?
kz-1il259d.e: When Alexander the Great offered to grant him a wish, Diogenes asked him to move – he was standing in the way of the sun.

kz-ckp83z.p: What did Heraclitus say one cannot do twice?
kz-ckp83z.e: The water is new, and you yourself have changed. Everything flows, as he is also said to have put it.

kz-msux97.p: Which novel begins by saying it was the best and the worst of times?
kz-msux97.e: Charles Dickens' novel is set in London and Paris during the French Revolution.

kz-1u3bzis.e: The novel about the Devil's visit to Moscow could first be published in 1966, 26 years after the author's death.

kz-1lhqmwp.p: Which writer hid behind the name George Eliot?
kz-1lhqmwp.e: She chose a man's name so that she would be taken seriously. Aurore Dupin did the same as George Sand.

kz-tiu45s.p: Who wrote “The Fishermen”, about the Inner Mission people of western Jutland by the Limfjord?
kz-tiu45s.e: The collective novel from 1928 has no main character – it is the community that it is about.

kz-11e0a74.p: Who wrote the poem about the stonemason “Jens Vejmand”?
kz-11e0a74.e: Carl Nielsen set it to music, and the song became so popular that it almost gained the status of a folk song.

kz-p2hinu.p: Which Soviet film from 1925 is famous for the scene on the steps in Odessa?
kz-p2hinu.e: Sergei Eisenstein's pram that rolls down the steps has been quoted in countless later films.

kz-1fvzqu6.e: The 1954 film was remade in Hollywood as the western “The Magnificent Seven”.

kz-vonyis.p: With which film did Kathryn Bigelow become the first woman to win an Oscar for directing?
kz-vonyis.e: She won in 2010 – beating, among others, her ex-husband James Cameron, who was nominated for “Avatar”.

kz-yn2790.p: Which Danish film won the Palme d'Or at Cannes in 2000?
kz-yn2790.e: Lars von Trier's musical also earned Björk the prize for best actress.

kz-1nr7d0j.p: Which Danish animated documentary was Oscar-nominated in three categories in 2022?
kz-1nr7d0j.e: The film tells the story of an Afghan boy's flight to Denmark and was nominated as documentary, animated feature and international feature.

kz-1vgi21s.p: Which drama series has won the most Emmy Awards ever?
kz-1vgi21s.e: The series won 59 statuettes over eight seasons.

kz-1dw8e9c.e: Balling also directed the Olsen Gang films and “The House on Christianshavn”. Lise Nørgaard came up with the idea and wrote many of the episodes.

kz-1x48fcv.p: Who composed the opera cycle “The Ring of the Nibelung”?
kz-1x48fcv.e: The four operas last about 15 hours in total and are performed every summer in Bayreuth.

kz-527kov.p: Which interval was called “the devil in music” in the Middle Ages?
kz-527kov.e: The interval of three whole tones sounds uneasy and is used often in heavy metal and in the theme from “The Simpsons”.

kz-erc5tw.p: Who in 1987 became the first woman in the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame?
kz-erc5tw.e: The queen of soul was inducted in the museum's second year.

kz-1kiizbz.p: Who composed “Elverskud” and became conductor of the Gewandhaus Orchestra in Leipzig?
kz-1kiizbz.e: Gade was his era's most famous Danish composer abroad and a close friend of Mendelssohn.

kz-bfgk0u.p: Who wrote the music for the national play “Elverhøj”?
kz-bfgk0u.e: The overture ends with the royal anthem and is known to many from the Olsen Gang's heist at the Royal Danish Theatre.

kz-1cwa1el.p: Who released the solo album “Værsgo” in 1973?
kz-1cwa1el.e: The record includes, among others, “Joanna” and “Det er i dag et vejr”.

kz-5mzynr.p: What was the name of Nintendo's 1980 handheld range with one game per unit?
kz-5mzynr.e: The directional cross, which all later consoles have inherited, was invented for the series.

kz-1vwhj4m.e: Kojima turned sneaking past the enemy into a whole genre.

kz-d6amo3.p: Which country has won the most medals at the Winter Olympics through history?
kz-d6amo3.e: A country with just over five million inhabitants has won over 400 medals – most of them in cross-country skiing and biathlon.

kz-1slj0c6.p: Which city became in 2012 the first to have hosted the Summer Olympics three times?
kz-1slj0c6.e: London hosted in 1908, 1948 and 2012. Paris reached three in 2024.

kz-1vcitcn.p: In which year did Denmark win Olympic gold in men's handball for the first time?
kz-1vcitcn.e: In Rio, Denmark beat France in the final. The gold was repeated in Paris in 2024.

kz-1qk7pom.p: Who scored the winning goal when Denmark beat England at Wembley in 1983?
kz-1qk7pom.e: The goal sent Denmark to the 1984 European Championship and marked the start of the national team's golden decade.

kz-1epy6p6.p: Who is the only player to have won the World Cup three times as a player?
kz-1epy6p6.e: The Brazilian won in 1958, 1962 and 1970. The first time he was 17.

kz-j5d15c.p: Which country won the first European Football Championship in 1960?
kz-j5d15c.e: Only four teams took part in the finals in France.

kz-145srbl.p: Who is the only goalkeeper to have won the Ballon d'Or?
kz-145srbl.e: “The Black Spider” from Dynamo Moscow won the award in 1963.

kz-nhp08r.p: Which vertebrate lives the longest – presumably over 250 years?
kz-nhp08r.e: The shark grows only one centimetre a year and only becomes sexually mature at around 150 years.

kz-1oja0wt.p: Which mammal is the only one covered in scales?
kz-1oja0wt.e: The scales are made of keratin, like fingernails. The pangolin is the world's most trafficked mammal.

kz-1haak5u.p: Which breeding bird in Denmark can fly for up to ten months without landing?
kz-1haak5u.e: It eats, sleeps and mates in the air, and lands only to brood.

kz-1mku5z8.e: Furesø is just under 38 metres deep. Arresø is the largest lake, but only a few metres deep.

kz-dpnkce.p: Who is the mother of Perseus – the woman Zeus visited as a shower of gold?
kz-dpnkce.e: Leda was visited by Zeus as a swan and Europa by Zeus as a bull.

kz-5gd1kl.p: What are the three goddesses of fate who spin the thread of human life called?
kz-5gd1kl.e: One spins the thread, another measures it, and the third cuts it off.

kz-15h9hqk.p: What are the three norns at Urd's well called?
kz-15h9hqk.e: They stand for past, present and future and determine the fate of both gods and humans.

kz-bfzqh.p: What is the name of Albus Dumbledore's brother?
kz-bfzqh.e: He is the innkeeper in Hogsmeade and helps Harry in the last book.

kz-1g42uso.p: Which magic potion gives the one who drinks it good luck?
kz-1g42uso.e: Veritaserum forces a person to tell the truth, and Amortentia is a love potion.

kz-72vfe6.p: What do the elves call Gandalf?
kz-72vfe6.e: The name means the Grey Pilgrim. Curunír is Saruman, and Aiwendil is Radagast.

kz-1e233t0.p: Who was Sauron's master in the First Age?
kz-1e233t0.e: Sauron was only a lieutenant of the first dark lord, whose story is told in “The Silmarillion”.

kz-102cvny.p: Which planet does Chewbacca come from?
kz-102cvny.e: The Wookiees live in giant trees on the forest-covered planet.

kz-13bs93s.e: Lucas handed the director's chair to his old teacher. Richard Marquand directed “Return of the Jedi”.

kz-re75ur.p: Which character did Walt Disney create before Mickey Mouse – and lost the rights to?
kz-re75ur.e: The loss of Oswald in 1928 led Disney to draw a mouse on the train journey home. The Disney company bought the rabbit back in 2006.

kz-19w7wta.p: Which year did H.C. Andersen publish his first fairy tales?
kz-19w7wta.e: The first booklet contained, among others, “The Tinderbox” and “The Princess and the Pea”.

kz-dyubku.p: What is the title of H.C. Andersen's autobiography?

o.o1: The Fairy Tale of My Life

kz-dyubku.e: The next two are novels. The autobiography begins with the words that his life is a beautiful fairy tale.

kz-5nkmye.p: Which sports brand was founded by Adi Dassler's brother?
kz-5nkmye.e: The two brothers fell out and each built a factory in the same small German town, Herzogenaurach.

kz-1apk1nx.p: Which company was originally called Tokyo Tsushin Kogyo?
kz-1apk1nx.e: The name was changed in 1958 because nobody outside Japan could pronounce it.

kz-1sjvsee.p: Which Danish company began in the attic of a manor house near Struer in 1925?
kz-1sjvsee.e: Peter Bang and Svend Olufsen built a radio that could be plugged straight into the wall socket instead of running on batteries.

kz-1vthcll.p: What is the Japanese theatre with masks and very slow movements called?
kz-1vthcll.e: Nō theatre is over 600 years old. Kabuki is the colourful and loud cousin, and bunraku is puppet theatre.

kz-31ghsh.e: The painter has put himself into the picture of the Spanish princess and her ladies-in-waiting.

kz-1ovmy3d.p: Which art movement did Piet Mondrian belong to?
kz-1ovmy3d.e: The Dutch group kept to straight lines, black, white and the three primary colours.

kz-183l7ll.e: The dark picture from 1885 was painted in Holland, before van Gogh found his strong colours in southern France.

kz-1dyv20h.p: Which architect designed the house Fallingwater over a waterfall?
kz-1dyv20h.e: The house in Pennsylvania from 1937 is regarded as a major work of American architecture.

kz-2ds0qy.p: What is a sentence that contains every letter of the alphabet called?
kz-2ds0qy.e: The best-known English example is the sentence about the quick brown fox that jumps over the lazy dog.

kz-e9yarz.p: What is the study of the origin of words called?
kz-e9yarz.e: Entomology is the study of insects – a confusion that has tripped up many people.

kz-1gzjz6q.p: Which Dane took off in 1906, as one of the first in Europe, in a motor-powered aircraft?
kz-1gzjz6q.e: The aircraft hung on a line from a pole on the island of Lindholm and flew 42 metres at a height of half a metre.

kz-1ukmpf.p: Who invented the Writing Ball, the world's first mass-produced typewriter?
kz-1ukmpf.e: The Danish priest and headmaster began production in 1870. The philosopher Nietzsche wrote on one of them.

kz-m2tr9g.p: Who in 1909 became the first woman to win the Nobel Prize in Literature?
kz-m2tr9g.e: The Swede wrote, among others, “The Saga of Gösta Berling” and the children's book “The Wonderful Adventures of Nils”.

kz-5b651u.p: Which Danish doctor won the Nobel Prize in 1903 for treating skin tuberculosis with light?
kz-5b651u.e: Finsen was born in the Faroe Islands and was Denmark's first Nobel laureate.

kz-1m4k25s.e: The head is split, singed and boiled. Many consider the eye the best bite.

o.o2: Egg, flour and breadcrumbs for coating

kz-ai6lk8.e: The vegetables are sweated as a flavour base for stocks, soups and sauces.

kz-l6ywew.p: Which of these is not one of the five basic sauces of French cuisine?
kz-l6ywew.e: The five are béchamel, velouté, espagnole, tomato sauce and hollandaise. Béarnaise is derived from hollandaise.

kz-1095urm.e: The food is vacuum-packed and cooked for a long time in water at a precise, low temperature.

kz-1u88zdp.p: What is autolyse in bread baking?

o.o1: Flour and water rest before kneading
o.o2: The dough rises in the fridge
o.o3: The yeast is dissolved in sugar
o.o4: The bread cools on a rack

kz-1u88zdp.e: During the rest, gluten starts to form on its own, so the dough needs less kneading.

kz-124mg26.p: Which green grape is one of the three main grapes in champagne?
kz-124mg26.e: The other two, Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier, are black-skinned.

kz-if6cwh.p: What is the “angel's share” in a whisky cask?

o.o4: The tax paid to the state

kz-if6cwh.e: About 2 per cent of the contents disappear through the wood each year.

kz-t700cx.p: Which Scottish island do the smoky whiskies Laphroaig, Lagavulin and Ardbeg come from?
kz-t700cx.e: The malt is dried over peat smoke, which gives the characteristic taste of tar and sea.

o.o1: High inflation and low growth at the same time
o.o3: Rising interest rates and rising growth

kz-10biupk.e: The combination hit the West after the 1973 oil crisis and is hard to fight, because the remedies for one make the other worse.

kz-1v4itbh.p: Which agreement from 1944 tied the world's currencies to the dollar and the dollar to gold?
kz-1v4itbh.e: The system collapsed in 1971, when the USA ended the dollar's link to gold.

kz-1k8cx1t.p: What does the Gini coefficient measure?
kz-1k8cx1t.e: 0 means that everyone has the same amount. 1 means that one person owns everything.

kz-1tkptbg.p: What does the Keeling Curve show?

o.o3: The thickness of the ozone layer
o.o4: The extent of the polar ice

kz-1tkptbg.e: The measurements on the Mauna Loa volcano in Hawaii have been carried out continuously since 1958.

kz-1ijf4pr.p: Which year did the Brundtland Report give the world the concept of sustainable development?
kz-1ijf4pr.e: The report defined it as development that meets the needs of the present without destroying the opportunities of future generations.

kz-lwd89o.p: Which nerve connects the brain with the heart, lungs and intestines?
kz-lwd89o.e: The name means the wandering nerve. It is the body's most important brake on pulse and stress.

kz-110jbwe.p: Which bone is the only one not connected to any other bone?
kz-110jbwe.e: The small horseshoe-shaped bone hangs in muscles and ligaments under the tongue.

kz-1j73vnf.p: What was the name of the three-wheeled Danish electric car from 1987?
kz-1j73vnf.e: The Mini-El was built in Randers to the inventor Steen V. Jensen's drawings and was called everything from a cabin scooter to a rolling vacuum cleaner.

kz-x9z77u.p: Which Greenpeace ship was sunk by French intelligence agents in 1985?
kz-x9z77u.e: The ship was in port in Auckland on its way to protest French nuclear tests. A photographer was killed.

kz-4s50ne.p: What is the name of the agreement that ended the war in Bosnia in 1995?
kz-4s50ne.e: The negotiations were held at an air base in Dayton, Ohio.

kz-gkykwr.p: What was the name of the first privately financed spacecraft to reach space with a pilot, in 2004?
kz-gkykwr.e: The craft won the Ansari X Prize of 10 million dollars by reaching over 100 kilometres altitude twice within two weeks.

kz-1geiq48.p: What was the name of the surveillance programme that Edward Snowden revealed in 2013?
kz-1geiq48.e: The programme gave the US intelligence agency NSA access to data from the major tech companies.

kz-451n17.p: What is the name of the EU's law on artificial intelligence, adopted in 2024?
